items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And I told H.E. I needed a trumpet player. Remember that?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I got out to home in 45. I'd just come back in 45. You said come back? Yeah, you see, I went overseas for a year and a half. That's right.
And I told H.E. I needed a trumpet player. Remember that?
